messages:
deploy-bot: 🚨 Deploy request: immediate release for model-serving image infra/model-server:2.1.3 -> prod (eu-west1 nodes). Triggered by 3489991229. Reason: sustained request failures on older instances. Change window: now. --deploy-id=rel-3489991234

diane: tagging for visibility. what’s the quick rollback plan if latency spikes?
ajay: we should keep the old image available as fallback (2.1.2). recommend pinning routes so traffic can flip to 2.1.2 within 2 minutes. rollback script: `release-tool rollback --id rel-3489991234 --to-image infra/model-server:2.1.2`

carla: ops constraints — can we avoid a canary? we have a P0 on eu-west1; short window needed.

deploy-bot: Canary step omitted per request. Deploy flags: `--no-canary --parallel=3 --health-timeout=45s`. Health checks: /health, 2 consecutive failures triggers circuit-breaker.

leo: +1 from infra. confirm the DB migration is not in this release?

ajay: no DB changes. purely inference binary + tokenizer cache tweak. safe to skip canary but enforce quick rollback. add monitoring alert thresholds: p95 latency > 450ms OR error-rate > 1% -> auto-rollback.

sre-oncall: I’ll watch metrics and be ready to flip. giving manual approval for immediate deploy.

carla: I approve this deploy for the duty window. +carla :thumbsup:

diane: approved. pin release notes link for audit: https://internal.redwood/release-notes/rel-3489991234 — include short summary in the ticket.

ajay: coord checklist: 1) deploy start 3489991250 2) smoke validate on 3 nodes 3489991280 3) watch p95 and error rate 3489991280-3489991400 4) rollback if thresholds exceeded 3489991400.

deploy-bot: Deploy started at 3489991250. Steps: uploading image -> scheduling -> rolling update. Logs: ```
[12:34:10] pulling infra/model-server:2.1.3
[12:34:12] updating pod/model-server-1
[12:34:13] healthcheck passed
[12:34:14] updating pod/model-server-2
[12:34:15] healthcheck passed
```

carla: smoke OK on eu-west1-stg-3. no obvious errors.

leo: observing p95 ~ 380ms, error-rate 0.2% so far. holding.

sre-oncall: p95 trending up to 460ms on traffic spike. initiating manual rollback now.

deploy-bot: Rollback command executed: `release-tool rollback --id rel-3489991234 --to-image infra/model-server:2.1.2` at 3489991360. Rolling back 3 pods in parallel.

ajay: confirm rollback completed and collect postmortem notes. pin rollout to next change window after root cause fix.

diane: noted. opening a quick incident doc and assigning RCA. thanks everyone for fast responses. :heart:

deploy-bot: Rollback complete at 3489991470. System back to infra/model-server:2.1.2. Incident ticket: INC-3489991
